title: DataLineageDocument
description: Single-document lineage of an object as it traverses sequential processing steps. The object's state at any step is reconstructed by replaying changes over initialState.

lineageId.description: Unique identifier of this lineage document.

objectId.description: Identifier of the business object being traced.

objectType.description: Domain type of the object, e.g. Order, Claim, Shipment.

initialState.description: Full object state before the first step. Keys are field paths (dot notation for nested fields).

steps.description: Ordered processing steps. sequence must be strictly increasing starting at 1.

checkpoints.description: Optional periodic full-state snapshots so long lineages need not replay from the start.

sequence.description: 1-based position of the step in the pipeline.

name.description: Human-readable step name shown in the UI.

system.description: Service or component that performed the step.

description.description: Optional longer explanation for the detail panel.

field.description: Field path in dot notation, e.g. 'shipping.address.city'.

oldValue.description: Value before the change. null for ADD.

newValue.description: Value after the change. null for SOFT_DELETE.

reason.description: Optional business justification, surfaced in the detail panel.
